# dsh-stats-hud
A sci-fi HUD for DeepSeek Harness: the session's stats become game-style level bars in a **vertical
column fixed to the far right edge** of the web UI — without touching the original stats line.
> **Install:** in the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app open **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste `https://git
hub.com/lauytgary/dsh_hud_plugin`, press **Install**, then **Enable now**. Full instructions ↓
## Changelog
**2026-11-05 — Adapted to DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 (the current Desktop release)**
- Re-audited every interface the HUD touches against the running `dsh 0.2.1-rc.5` (the Desktop app's
bundled runtime): `conversation.composer.dock` is still declared by the composer bar and still decl
aration-gated, so the `ctx.slots.inject(...)` registration stays as-is; the dock's `id` / `order` /
`label` options, the `useSession` / `useProjection` standard props, all four projections (`sessionSt
ats`, `tokenUsage`, `contextPressure`, `contextBreakdown`) with unchanged field names, the `[data-co
mposer-card]` / `data-slot` DOM markers, the `style[data-plugin]` style-ownership convention and `wi

ndow.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` are unchanged.
- The stock stats line is now **two** do
ck entries (`activity`, order 0, and `usage`, order 1) instead of one `stats` entry. The HUD keeps i

ts own id (`dsh-stats-hud`, order 1), so it is added beside them and never replaces one.
- Formatter
s re-synced with the 0.2.1 stock helpers: `tok/s` rounds to an integer from 10 up (was 100), and the

cache-hit percentage keeps one decimal for a near-full hit instead of rounding up to `100%`.
- Adde
d the missing `.gsh-sub` rule, so the THROUGHPUT unit (`tok/s`) finally has its own small muted styl

e.
- Manifest: dropped the unused `dsh.client.inject` entries (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`, `@d
eepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` — 0.2.1 uses `inject` only as a load-order hint, and this bun
dle requires nothing but `react`) and the `react` peer dependency (`require("react")` resolves throu
gh the client platform seed, so the peer only made pnpm install a stray `react@18` into the profile)

; declared `dsh.manifestVersion: 1`. Package version bumped to `0.1.2`.
- Docs: the Install section
is now a Desktop-first walkthrough (**Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin → Enable n
ow**) with a CLI fallback, a “Check that it works” step and a troubleshooting table; both plugin-lis
t screenshots were replaced with 0.2.1 captures of the Plugins page.
**2026-09-11 — Verified against DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 (no code changes needed)**

After DSH moved to declaration-gated slots (`0.1.2-rc.1`), an install of this

## Instruments (all-English, LLM terminology)
| Instrument | Data | Full scale | Past full scale |
| `CLOCK` badge | Local time (24h) + `DS API PEAK` / `DS API OFF PEAK` rate | Peak = Mon–Fri Beijing

s are OFF-PEAK (half price) | PEAK orange tint, OFF-PEAK green tint |
| `STEPS / TURN` rolling rows
| Steps / turns as odometer drums (like the CONTEXT rows) | — | Drums spin up on mount, roll on chan

ge |
| `LLM / TOOLS` dual bar | Two columns (labels over values), bar segments = raw LLM:TOOLS time

ratio | No cap — 2:1 time means 2:1 bar | — |
| `THROUGHPUT` gauge | tokens/s (throughput), centered
title, combined centered readout (`146 tok/s`) | Redline auto-scales 200→300→400… (arc ticks follow

centered readout (`146 tok/s`) | Redline auto-scales 200→300→400… (arc ticks follow) | — |

## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness `dsh` **0.2.1-rc.5** (macOS; the Desktop app's bundled runtime). Slot registratio
n is declaration-gated, so the plugin registers through the `ctx.slots.inject(...)` pattern — see Ch

angelog
- pnpm (for plugin management)
## How it works
- Registers into the `conversation.composer.dock` slot (id `dsh-stats-hud`, order 1) — **only to rec
eive the session-scoped hooks** (`useSession`/`useProjection`); the panel itself is `position: fixed
`, takes no layout space, and the stock stats line stays untouched. Registration goes through `ctx.s
lots.inject(...)`, which waits for the slot to be declared by its parent entry (required since DSH m

ade slot registration declaration-gated).
- Data comes from the same projections the stock UI uses:
`useProjection("sessionStats")`, `useProjection("tokenUsage")`, `useProjection("contextPressure")` a

nd `useProjection("contextBreakdown")` — zero host-side changes.
- `exports.inject = ["slots"]` is m
andatory: DSH's ctx is a strict proxy, and reading any service not listed there throws (`service "sl
ots" is not declared by your plugin`). The package-level `dsh.client` declaration needs no `inject`

list — the bundle requires nothing but `react`.
- The panel is `pointer-events: none` (click-through
); only the CONTEXT USAGE bar re-enables pointer events so its hover tooltip works.
